propositions: The review bot computes per-call token usage fields (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens) in result["_usage"] but discards them without recording to CloudWatch, yielding zero token visibility today.

Token usage aggregation must sum across Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent steps that expose _usage in their step outputs, excluding Pass-1 finder batch usage which does not surface per-finder _usage (deferred to follow-up).

The finalize.py metrics assembler must aggregate input/output/cache/total token counts into coverage["metrics"] across all succeeded steps bearing _usage, tolerating steps without _usage (contributing 0).

The voter.py publisher must emit exactly five CloudWatch metrics (review_bot_llm_input_tokens, review_bot_llm_output_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_read_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_write_tokens, review_bot_llm_total_tokens) with Unit="Count" to Namespace="rebar/host" via boto3 put_metric_data, plus a greppable LLM_TOKEN_USAGE JSON line to stderr/journald.
Token metric emission must be best-effort (swallowing boto3 import/credential/network failures) and occur only after a successful vote, never affecting the vote outcome.
